# Viktor Maruna

> Personal website of Viktor Maruna, a Cloud Solution Architect & Data Engineer based in Slovakia, specializing in Data & AI — generative AI, large language models (LLMs), data platforms, and cloud architecture on Microsoft Azure.

Viktor Maruna designs and builds Data & AI solutions. His areas of expertise:

- Cloud architecture: Microsoft Azure, cloud-native solutions, scalable infrastructure
- Data engineering: data pipelines, data platforms, ETL/ELT, data lakes, lakehouses
- AI and machine learning: generative AI, large language models (LLMs), ML solutions, AI-powered applications
- Data & AI strategy: enterprise data & AI architecture, solution design, technical advisory

He speaks English and Slovak. This site is a single-page personal profile; his technical writing is published on the dev blog listed below.
